correctness.rationale: Symmetric/antisymmetric rail decomposition of the 2n-vertex weighted Laplacian gives τ=(1/2)det(L_path+2diag w). With u>0 the positive root of nu²+2(1-B)u-2B=0, set endpoint w=u/2 and interior w=u²/[2(1+u)]; these sum to B. The corresponding positive-definite A has AR(1) inverse (A^-1)_ij=ρ^(|i-j|+1)/(1-ρ²), ρ=(1+u)^-1, hence constant diagonal and equal gradient 2(A^-1)_ii. Strict concavity of logdet on diagonal perturbations proves global unique maximizer even against asymmetric or zero-rung allocations. AR(1) determinant computes τ*=u(u+2)(1+u)^(n-2)/2; series expansion gives the endpoint premium and all stated limits.
